marketing_wrapper: Four frames, no device bezel: a rounded-corner screen crop (~70%) under a large serif/italic caption on a blurred photo, flat electric blue (#0000fe) or black field. 01 and 02 show the real camera viewfinder (though 01 overlays caption words 'for FRIENDS' on the UI). 03 shows a locked/developing grid with a marketing-placed notification. 04 is a single film photo with a thumbnail strip, mostly photography. In-app text is almost absent, so type cannot be judged from UI.

typography.display: Not visible in-app. Marketing pairs a light high-contrast serif with italic (disposable, the moment, aesthetic) and a heavy all-caps grotesque (CAMERA, FRIENDS)
typography.body: unsure (only a notification in SF bold: 'SNAPS DEVELOPED')
typography.numerals: rounded/regular small counters (6, 2) on the roll stack; '10+' badge
typography.case_and_tracking: Notification title all-caps bracketed by 💥 emoji; marketing mixes lowercase serif italic with caps grotesque

palette.accent_strategy: The viewfinder image is the screen; chrome is translucent dark circles and a white shutter, with a single red-orange used for the focus brackets, the badge and the flash bolt. Locked undeveloped shots are shown as blurred purple-red-orange gradients with a lock glyph.
palette.source: palette.json 02: #0000fe 33% = marketing blue field; 03: #000000 36% = black grid gutters/background, #983345 / #46304d = locked-tile gradients; 01/04 dominated by photo colours. Red-orange accents are visual estimates.

shape.radius_language: large: ~36pt on the full-screen viewfinder corners, circles for every control (shutter, flash, add-friend, inbox), ~8pt rounded tiles in the photo stack, ~20pt notification card
shape.borders_shadows: White ring around the shutter; thin dark gutters between grid tiles; no shadows
shape.materials: Dark translucent/blurred circular buttons over the live image; film grain in photos

liquid_glass_visible: unclear: the circular buttons over the viewfinder are translucent and could be glass, but no lensing is visible
density: low: a full-bleed viewfinder with four small corner controls and one big shutter
layout: Camera-first: rounded full-height viewfinder, add-friend top-left, inbox with count badge top-right, bottom row of roll-stack counter / large white shutter / flash; a tab bar sits under the viewfinder (avatar, camera, friends) but is cropped. Developed roll appears as a two-column grid where undeveloped shots are locked gradient tiles.
navigation: Bottom tab bar (partly visible in 01: profile avatar, camera, friends glyph with blue dot) below the viewfinder; no top bar.
imagery_and_icons: Users' film-processed photos; filled white glyphs in dark circles; a lock glyph on blurred gradient placeholders; app icon is a glowing orange smiley on black; emoji inside notification copy (💥, 🎞).
signature_visual_move: Undeveloped shots sit in the grid as blurred colour-gradient tiles with a padlock until the roll 'develops'.
tells_present: Emoji as icons (💥 and 🎞 in the develop notification)
Gradient backgrounds (locked-shot placeholders, though they carry meaning)

direction_fit.why: The locked gradient tiles make the delayed develop visible as UI, and the camera mirrors the stock Camera layout with a big white shutter, as reviews said. Too little chrome is shown to say much about type or palette.

notes: Too marketing-heavy to judge typography and navigation; 04 is almost entirely a photo. Captions overlap real UI in 01. The gradient tiles are semantic (locked), so the gradient tell is weak here.
